categories.main_business_segments: Cofoe Medical Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the medical device industry, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and service of personal health management products across five main categories: health monitoring, rehabilitation aids, respiratory support, medical care, and traditional Chinese medicine physiotherapy. The company also manages a comprehensive sales network including e-commerce platforms, chain pharmacies, and self-operated stores, with a growing presence in overseas markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technological innovation with dedicated research institutes in medical electronics, rehabilitation medicine, biosensing, innovative materials, and respiratory support. It employs flexible production methods based on sales forecasts, adhering to strict quality management systems including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, and ISO45001. Advanced manufacturing incorporates AI and digital management systems for process optimization, quality control, and smart manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cofoe serves a broad customer base including hospitals, pharmacies, healthcare institutions, and individual consumers, particularly targeting elderly and chronic disease patients. Its products are widely distributed through online platforms and offline retail chains, catering to domestic markets primarily in China and expanding internationally to Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas. The company also focuses on specialized segments such as hearing aid users through its dedicated hearing centers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Changsha, Yueyang, and Nantong, and sales networks covering over 20 provinces and cities domestically. Internationally, it has expanded into more than 60 countries and regions across Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas, with localized operations and product registrations in key overseas markets including South America and Southeast Asia. It has established subsidiaries and joint ventures in Hong Kong and other regions to support global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cofoe operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and distribution. It sources raw materials and components from upstream suppliers, manages in-house production, and controls extensive sales and service channels. The company also engages in brand product procurement and agency product distribution, integrating supply chain collaboration to optimize cost and efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in core product categories with a focus on innovation, smart healthcare integration, and product upgrades. Key R&D directions include multi-parameter health monitoring systems, advanced respiratory devices with IoT connectivity, intelligent rehabilitation aids, and medical care consumables. It actively pursues AI integration, remote health management, and personalized healthcare solutions, supported by collaborations with universities and research institutions to accelerate technology commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Cofoe generates revenue primarily through the sale of medical devices and healthcare products via direct sales, e-commerce platforms, and retail chains. It also earns income from agency sales of third-party brands and provides professional services such as hearing aid fitting and after-sales support. The company’s revenue streams include product sales, government subsidies, and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cofoe is positioned as a leading domestic brand in personal health management medical devices with strong market recognition and a diversified product portfolio. It competes with other major Chinese and international medical device manufacturers, leveraging its integrated R&D, manufacturing, and sales capabilities. The company maintains competitive advantages through innovation, quality control, extensive sales channels, and brand influence, ranking among the top 50 medical device companies in China by revenue.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Cofoe reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.98 billion, representing a 4.53% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 311.75 million, up 22.60%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 6.42 billion with a stable asset-liability ratio of 25.23%. It has demonstrated steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by increased cash flow from operations and ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cofoe emphasizes delivering comprehensive, high-quality personal health management solutions covering the full lifecycle of consumers. Its products are differentiated by technological innovation, multi-functionality, and smart features such as AI integration and IoT connectivity. The company’s strong brand portfolio, extensive sales network, and professional service capabilities provide customers with reliable, convenient, and personalized healthcare products and services, fostering long-term trust and loyalty.
